routines.name: Commercial Property Rating Pipeline CALC-STEP-01 to CALC-STEP-14
routines.evidence_text: The calculation engine executes a sequential 14-step routine. Floating-point values are retained to six (6) decimal places during execution. Stage I: Unadjusted Base Core Rating (Steps 1 to 4) – Step 1: Base Physical Damage Rate determination (Rbase). – Step 2: Construction Class relativity adjustment (Fconst). – Step 3: Occupancy Hazard loading (Focc). – Step 4: Public Protection Classification modification (Mppc). Stage II: Protection & Secondary Adjustments (Steps 5 to 7) – Step 5: Automatic Sprinkler System credit application (Cspk). – Step 6: Deductible Relativity factor scaling (Fded). – Step 7: Coinsurance compliance check and penalty evaluation. Stage III: Discretionary & Surcharge Layers (Steps 8 to 11) – Step 8: Underwriting Experience Modification Factor application (EMF). – Step 9: Environmental and Congestion Surcharge loading. – Step 10: Catastrophic Peril rate addition (Rcat). – Step 11: Final Building Core Premium aggregation. Stage IV: Endorsements, Levies & Final Rounding (Steps 12 to 14) – Step 12: Commercial Endorsements and Extensions aggregation. – Step 13: Municipal Fire Assessment Levy calculation. – Step 14: Total Policy Premium formulation and statutory minimum floor check.
steps: Retrieve unadjusted base rate Rbase from Table TBL-BASE-RATE (Page 17) matching DATA-038 and DATA-006. Ratestep1 = Rbase
Retrieve Fconst from Table TBL-CONST-REL (Page 18) based on DATA-013 and DATA-021. Rate step2 = Ratestep1 x Fconst
Retrieve Focc from Table TBL-OCC-LOAD (Page 19). Rate step3 = Rate step2 x Focc
Retrieve Mppc from Table TBL-PROT-CRED Part A (Page 20) matching DATA-028. Ratestep4 = Rate step3 x Mppc
Retrieve sprinkler credit Cspk from Table TBL-PROT-CRED Part B (Page 20). The credit is applied as a direct multiplicative discount against the running rate: Ratestep5 = Ratestep4 x (1.0 - Cspk)
Retrieve Fded from Table TBL-DED-REL (Page 22) matching DATA-044. Rate step6 = Ratestep5 x Fded

Evaluate Coinsurance compliance and apply site congestion loading: Coinsurance Penalty Factor = Declared_TIV / True_Replacement_Cost x (Coinsurance_Required/100) Ratestep7 = Rate step6 x site_congestion_factor x max(1.0, Coinsurance Penalty Factor)
Apply the underwriter schedule rating credit or debit (DATA-045): Rate step8 = Ratestep7 x DATA-045
Apply statutory environmental surcharge factor Senv: Rate step9 = Rate step8 x (1.0 + Senv) Where Senv = 0.045000 for risks situated in ZONE_4 and ZONE_5; 0.000000 otherwise.
Retrieve catastrophic peril rate Rcat from Table TBL-CAT-PERIL (Page 21) based on seismic and windstorm exposure. Rate step10 = Rate step9 + Rcat
Compute core physical damage premium by applying Rate step10 per $100 of Total Insured Value (DATA-042): Premiumcore = round_half_up ( DATA-042 / 100 x Rate step10 , 2 )

Sum all active optional endorsement premiums detailed in Section 6: Premium endorsements = END-001+END-002+END-003+END-005+END-006+END-007+END-008 Premium subtotal = Premiumcore + Premium endorsements
Calculate mandatory municipal fire department assessment: Levy fire = round_half_up(Premium subtotal x 0.025,2) This levy applies strictly to properties located in municipal zones ZONE_1 and ZONE_2.
Compute final total gross premium and enforce statutory minimum retained premium: Premiumgross = Premium subtotal + Levy fire Premium final = max($750.00, round_half_up(Premiumgross,2))

routines.name: BR-PROT-02 – Additive Protection Adjustments
routines.evidence_text: 4.3.1 Business Rule: BR-PROT-02 – Additive Protection Adjustments Notwithstanding algorithmic sequence guidelines, protection credits and occupancy hazard surcharges must be evaluated additively against the base rate during preliminary rate composition: Rprelim = Rbase x (1.0 + (Focc-1.0)-Creditsprot)
routines.notes: Alternative/conflicting formula for same rate composition as CALC-STEP-03 to CALC-STEP-05 sequential multiplicative chain (Rate step3 = Rate step2 x Focc; Ratestep5 = Ratestep4 x (1.0-Cspk)); preserved verbatim and flagged as conflict for review instead of choosing one. Symbol Creditsprot defined nowhere else; kept verbatim and flagged as undefined.
